slide.title: Implemented: proposed to implemented at a delivery commit
slide.takeaway: A code-free proposal and its implemented successor share one identity; implementation is refused unless the evidence verifies and is current at the delivery commit.

item.label: Code-free proposal and successor
item.description: A proposed revision needs no code and names baseline: none, or an implemented ancestor revision of the same record for a successor. The baseline is kept apart from parents and never inferred.

references.note: validateIntentRevision: baseline, delivery and per-intent code rules.
resolveTechnical checks that a baseline is an implemented ancestor.

criterion_links.rationale: Proposed Components, Systems and data entities are publishable without code evidence.
A successor proposal keeps the stable identity and pins its implemented baseline revision explicitly.

item.label: Delivery resolved once
item.description: The CLI resolves --delivery (or delivery.commit) once to a full OID and binds it to the manifest source repository; a different repository or two different commits are refused.

references.note: resolveDelivery binds the delivery commit and repository at the command boundary.

criterion_links.rationale: The explicit implementation operation records the exact source view its evidence was validated against.

item.label: Policy validation before writing
item.description: Under the lock, technicalpolicy verifies original bytes and delivery currency for the entity and every implemented edge; interactions check both member endpoints. Diagnostics refuse the revision.

references.note: checkImplementationPolicy builds the candidate with exact endpoint facts and calls ValidateCandidate.

criterion_links.rationale: Missing, forged or stale supplied evidence refuses the transition.
Validation records intent and evidence only; no verification, integration or review decision is written.

item.label: Locked, idempotent publication
item.description: Publication requires every current head as a parent, admits only current new pins, replays identical retries and writes nothing when any check fails.

references.note: WriteTechnicalRevision: replay, parents, candidate history, pin, view and policy checks, then write.
admitDefinitionPins: new pins must be current unless retained or self.

criterion_links.rationale: Adding implementation evidence appends a revision and leaves the committed proposal intact.

item.label: Lifecycle through the public CLI
item.description: A temporary Git repository exercises refusal before adoption, a code-free proposal, the implemented revision at a full OID, a proposed successor, retries and pinning from a slide.

references.note: End-to-end proposed, implemented and successor lifecycle with slide pinning.

criterion_links.rationale: The test proves the proposal remains readable after implementation is recorded.

item.label: Evidence policy cases
item.description: Pure movement keeps the original reference; edited bytes give stale_delivery_evidence with no files written; forged digests, foreign repositories and implemented edges to proposed members refuse.

references.note: Movement, drift, forged digest, foreign repository and mixed-intent System cases.

criterion_links.rationale: The refusals and the accepted movement case are exercised against real Git history.
